Sundae Bar AI PLC
("sundae_bar" or the "Company")
Launch of AI Agent Subscription on sundae_bar platform
Adding a scalable recurring revenue stream for the Company

Sundae Bar AI PLC (AIM: SBAR), the enterprise AI platform, announces the launch of its full monthly subscription offering on the sundae_bar platform enabling businesses access to ready-made or bespoke AI Agents on a monthly subscription basis. This new offering marks one of the Company’s most significant milestones, bringing the core elements of the sundae_bar roadmap together in one commercial product and adding a new recurring revenue stream.

For the first time, customers, including businesses and individuals, can subscribe to sundae_bar for AI Agent solutions as an ongoing service. The subscription includes nine ready-made Agents together with Scout, which assists in finding or building bespoke Agents around each customer’s requirements using Skills available through sundae_bar, including those developed through SN121 challenges. This expected recurring revenue stream will be in addition to the current one-off marketplace sales and bespoke enterprise deployments.

Most businesses understand that AI can help but lack the time or technical expertise to choose models, engineer prompts and combine multiple tools. sundae_bar removes that complexity: customers can simply describe the work they need completed and the platform identifies or builds the right Agent for the job. The Board believes this combination of simplicity, bespoke capability and built-in quality checks positions sundae_bar strongly within the growing AI Agent market.
Highlights
Subscriptions from £25 per month, with usage credits and customer-controlled top-ups.
Nine ready-made Agents plus Scout’s ability to build bespoke Agents.
Adds recurring revenue alongside marketplace sales and enterprise deployments.
More than 700 Skills, Agents and other capabilities available through the platform.
Agents retain context, run on a schedule and undergo quality checks before deployment.
A Broader Commercial Model
The subscription launch expands sundae_bar three complementary routes to revenue:
one-off purchases of AI Agents and Skills through the marketplace;
bespoke deployments for enterprise customers; and
monthly subscriptions providing ongoing access to ready-made and custom Agents.

Customers can launch a ready-made Agent or ask Scout to build one around a specific requirement. Skills are checked for suitability, and every newly created Agent must pass a quality check before deployment.

The launch moves sundae_bar beyond individual transactions into an ongoing commercial relationship with customers. The Board believes the combination of recurring subscriptions, one-off marketplace sales and enterprise deployments provides the Company with its clearest path yet to commercialisation at scale.
Jill Kenney Chief Executive Officer commented

"The last phase connected SN121 to our commercial platform and created an engine for continuous development. This new offering launch turns that engine into a scalable subscription product, bringing together our ready-made Agents, Scout and growing Skills library.

"Businesses should not need to understand which AI model or workflow they require. They should be able to describe the work they need completed and trust sundae_bar to identify or build the right Agent. That simplicity, combined with recurring revenue and a platform that becomes more capable as its library grows, is what makes this such an important milestone."
Development Progress
The subscription platform is the next step from the integration announced in August 2026, when winning Skills developed through the Agent Lab began flowing into the sundae_bar marketplace.

The Agent Lab has completed 25 challenges and attracted more than 6,000 competing submissions. Development over the past three months has been guided by customer requests and platform demand signals. Winning Skills are now used within ready-made Agents and are available to Scout when building Agents around customer requirements, creating a direct route from customer demand to commercial product. The Agent Lab operates through SN121 on Bittensor, enabling developers to work on multiple challenges in parallel without requiring a proportional increase in the Company’s internal development headcount.
Outlook

The Company’s priorities are to grow subscription adoption, convert platform usage into paying customers, increase the number of ready-made Agents and continue expanding the Skills available to Scout. Monthly subscriptions provide a clearer path to growing recurring revenue, alongside further commercial opportunities from the marketplace and enterprise offering.
For further information visit sundaebar.ai

About sundae_bar

Following its successful AIM admission in June 2025, sundae_bar is building the go-to commercial platform for AI in business. Through a simple monthly subscription, sundae_bar gives businesses one simple interface to access and deploy AI. Tell it what needs to get done, and Scout identifies or builds the right Agent from a growing library of AI Skills and Agents. With more than 700 AI Skills and Agents already available, sundae_bar can support work across core business functions including marketing, finance, research and workflow automation. That capability can expand rapidly, with new Skills and Agents continuously added to the platform and made available across the customer base.

Behind this continuous development is Subnet 121 (SN121), sundae_bar’s AI development engine on the Bittensor network. Rather than relying solely on an internal development team, sundae_bar can open business requirements to a global network of developers competing to build the best-performing solutions. This allows sundae_bar to develop and test new AI capabilities in parallel, expanding the platform at scale and speed.
The result is an Enterprise AI platform that gets broader and more capable as it grows, while making that expanding intelligence simple for businesses to put to work.
